descriptions.rgb: Across all five frames, the camera wearer is in a cultivated field with dense rows of leafy green plants in the foreground, bare soil and black irrigation lines between rows, and trees along the distant horizon. In frame 1, a person is partly cut off at the upper-left edge, about 1–2 m away and facing generally toward the camera wearer; nearby plants are within the wearer’s arm’s reach. In frames 2–4, the same person appears crouched or seated ahead at roughly 1–3 m, shifting from near the center to the right side as the camera turns and moves along the crop row; the person is oriented partly toward the camera and occasionally appears to look in its direction. Several sacks or bundles lie on the ground behind and to either side of the person, separated from them by roughly 1–4 m, while a yellow bundle is farther back near the center-left; none is within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach. By frame 5, the leafy plants fill most of the lower and central view and partly occlude the soil and irrigation lines, while the person is near the upper-right edge, partially out of frame and about 2–3 m away, indicating that the camera has moved or turned leftward relative to them.
